# gi.ags.transform.ags_proj_to_brgi_project { #bedrock_ge.gi.ags.transform.ags_proj_to_brgi_project }

```python
gi.ags.transform.ags_proj_to_brgi_project(ags_proj, crs)
```

Maps the AGS 3 'PROJ' group to a Bedrock GI 'Project' table.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type         | Description                                     | Default    |
|----------|--------------|-------------------------------------------------|------------|
| ags_proj | pd.DataFrame | The AGS 3 'PROJ' group.                         | _required_ |
| crs      | CRS          | The coordinate reference system of the project. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                 | Description                                         |
|--------|----------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
|        | DataFrame\[Project\] | DataFrame[Project]: The Bedrock GI 'Project' table. |
